title: 妻役を確保せよ / Secure a Wife

lines.jp: ハア…ダメだな。
lines.en: Haa… Yeah, no.
What?!

lines.jp: アーニャこのははやだ。
lines.en: Anya cannot accept this mama.

lines.en: You’re just not going to cut it for the mother role, Franky.

lines.en: You’re literally a spy. Couldn’t you have done my disguise better?

lines.en: There’s only so much I can do with your height and physique.

lines.en: (Thoughts) We were able to pass the written exam to get into the prestigious Eden College, but who knew the interview process’s next stage demanded the attendance of both parents?

lines.jp: しかたない。婚活するか…。
lines.en: Very well. I guess I’ll have to explore my options.
